# develop

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/develop"
```

Package develop keeps a repository's develop branch in step with main.

Sync opens one pull request that merges main into develop whenever main is ahead: it branches off develop, merges main in with a server\-side \(GitHub\-signed\) merge commit so the signature ruleset needs no bypass, and opens the pull request into develop for the user to merge. It is idempotent — an open sync pull request, or a develop already level with main, makes it do nothing. A merge conflict is reported, not forced, as resolving it needs a human.

<a name="OpenResult"></a>
## type OpenResult

OpenResult is the outcome of Open.

```go
type OpenResult struct {
    Branch, Base string
    // Skipped is non-empty when Branch is long-lived and gets no pull request.
    Skipped string
    // Existing is a pull request from Branch that was already open.
    Existing *github.Pull
    // Title is the pull request title (the branch's latest commit subject).
    Title string
    // Labels are applied to both the pull request and the tracking issue.
    Labels []string
    // Pull and Issue are what Open created (Issue may be reused).
    Pull  *github.Pull
    Issue *github.Issue
}
```

<a name="Open"></a>
### func Open

```go
func Open(ctx context.Context, api OpenAPI, opts OpenOptions) (OpenResult, error)
```

Open opens a pull request for Branch into Base on its first push \(when no pull request from it is open yet\) and a tracking issue mapped one\-to\-one to that pull request, both labelled with pr\-tracking and the branch's Conventional Commit type. It is idempotent — a branch that already has an open pull request, or a long\-lived branch, does nothing — and reuses an open tracking issue a closed pull request left behind.

<a name="SyncOptions"></a>
## type SyncOptions

SyncOptions configures Sync.

```go
type SyncOptions struct {
    // Base is the branch kept up to date (default develop), From the branch
    // merged into it (default main).
    Base, From string
    // DryRun only reports what it would do; it makes no branch, merge or
    // pull request.
    DryRun bool
}
```

<a name="SyncResult"></a>
## type SyncResult

SyncResult is the outcome of a Sync.

```go
type SyncResult struct {
    Base, From string
    // Behind are the commits From has that Base lacks, oldest first.
    Behind []github.Commit
    // UpToDate is set when Base already contains From (nothing to do).
    UpToDate bool
    // Existing is an open sync pull request that was already there.
    Existing *github.Pull
    // Conflict is set when From cannot be merged into Base without
    // resolving a conflict; no pull request is opened.
    Conflict bool
    // Branch is the branch the sync pull request was opened from.
    Branch string
    // Opened is the pull request Sync opened.
    Opened *github.Pull
}
```

### func Sync

```go
func Sync(ctx context.Context, api API, opts SyncOptions) (SyncResult, error)
```
